items.title: Exercise special termination right (§ 57 Abs. 1 TKG) due to price increase
items.quote: Dieses Recht können Sie innerhalb von drei Monaten ausüben, nachdem Ihnen diese Mitteilung zugegangen ist; der Vertrag endet dann frühestens mit dem Tag, an dem die Preiserhöhung wirksam wird.
items.computation: The letter is dated Monday 13.04.2026 and was presumably sent by ordinary post the same day. As this is a private company's letter (not an administrative act), there is no statutory delivery fiction such as §122 Abs.2 AO; absent an actual proof of receipt, the customary assumption for ordinary domestic post is 3 days, giving a presumed Zugang (receipt) on Thursday 16.04.2026. The 3-month period to exercise the special termination right begins the day after receipt (§187 Abs.1 BGB), i.e. 17.04.2026, and ends, per §188 Abs.2 BGB, on the day of the third following month that bears the same number as the day of receipt — i.e. 16.07.2026. That date (Thursday) is a business day in NW (no public holiday), so no shift under §193 BGB is needed. This is the last day the termination must reach the provider to validly use the special right; a termination exercised before 01.06.2026 would still only end the contract at the earliest on 01.06.2026 (the effective date of the increase), while one exercised later ends the contract with immediate effect on the day it is received, up to this final deadline of 16.07.2026.
